session.name: marasil_session
session.description: Sanctum cookie (name follows SESSION_COOKIE/APP_NAME); send X-CSRF-TOKEN for mutations.

internalHmac.name: X-Internal-Signature
internalHmac.description: HMAC-SHA256 of timestamp.METHOD.path.sha256(body). X-Internal-Timestamp and X-Internal-Nonce also required.
